团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
Business Support is a key support function of Saturn Collaboration Team under IEGG. This team plays role of resource coordination, operational improvements, and two-directional communication inside and outside of the team.
We are looking for an passionate candidate with high potential to join our team. The successful candidate shall have exceptional strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with cross-functional teams. This is an exciting and challenging position for a motivated candidate who is passionate about the gaming industry and enjoys working with professionals from diverse backgrounds.
Key responsibilities: 
Business coordination: Close work with functional teams to leverage all support resources for business success within existing organizational framework & process
Business communications: Develop presentation for upper management, partner studio and peer teams, to facilitate and accelerate business growth
Business analysis: Stay up-to date on industry trends and market insights for team knowledge share and decision-making reference
Business operation: Prepare routine review and reports, identify opportunity areas, and initiate practices to improve operations

业务支持（Business Support）是 IEGG 旗下 Saturn 协作团队的核心支撑职能。该团队负责资源协调、运营优化，以及团队内外部的双向沟通。
我们正在寻找一位充满热情、具备高潜力的候选人加入团队。理想人选需具备卓越的战略思维、分析和问题解决能力，并能高效地与跨职能团队沟通协作。这是一个充满挑战与机遇的岗位，适合热爱游戏行业、乐于与多元背景专业人士共事的候选人。
岗位职责：业务协调：与职能团队紧密合作，在既有组织架构和流程内整合各类支持资源，助力业务成功。
业务沟通：为管理层、合作工作室及兄弟团队制作汇报材料，促进沟通协作，加速业务增长。
业务分析：持续关注行业趋势与市场洞察，为团队知识共享和决策提供支持。
业务运营：准备定期复盘与报告，识别改进空间，主动提出并推动运营优化实践。

岗位要求
Structured-thinking, analytical, problem-solving skills are critical to success in this position. Experience in financial analysis, corporate strategy, is preferred
Avid gamer, passion in prevailing titles and innovative indies. ARPG hardcore is preferred
Demonstrate insights and passion in the gaming industry
Courage to stand own ground and take initiatives
Solid presentation and professional communication skills, with attention to details
Strong interpersonal skills to coordinate with cross-functional teams
Fluent in Mandarin and English, both oral and written
具备结构化思维、数据分析与问题解决能力；有财务分析或企业战略相关经验者优先。
热爱游戏，对主流大作及创新独立游戏充满热情；熟悉 ARPG（动作角色扮演类）游戏者优先。
对游戏行业有深入理解与热情。
具备独立思考与主动推动的能力。
具备良好的汇报展示能力与专业沟通技巧，注重细节。
拥有优秀的人际协调能力，能高效推动跨团队合作。
中英文听说读写流利。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。
Work Location: China-Shanghai
